project_type: C11 programming language implementation (compiler, VM, HTTP server, CLI tools)
build_system: Make with clang, single Makefile in root. Compiles all src/*.c into build/vek binary. SQLite amalgamation vendored.
test_framework: Custom C test binaries (tests/test_*.c compiled to build/test_*) + shell integration tests (tests/run_integration.sh, tests/test_http.sh, tests/test_web_app.sh)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'make' to ensure build succeeds. 2. Run 'make test' to run unit + integration tests. 3. For docs-only changes, verify markdown renders correctly and cross-references are valid.
setup_instructions: Build requires clang (C11) and Linux x86_64. Run 'make' from root directory. No external package manager dependencies beyond system compiler.
environment_constraints: Linux x86_64 with clang. Project has no external deps beyond vendored sqlite3.c. vekd is a separate binary not yet created - Phase 4 is brand new implementation work.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns in src/. Each CLI command is its own cmd_*.c file. Headers are paired with .c files. Makefile auto-discovers src/*.c files.
key_patterns: CLI commands in separate cmd_*.c files with cmd_*_run() entry points registered in cli.c. HTTP server uses event loop (epoll) with connection callbacks. SQLite amalgamation vendored as src/sqlite3.c/.h. All stdlib modules as stdlib_*.c files.
directory_structure: src/ - all C source files (80+), tests/ - test files (C unit tests + shell integration tests), docs/ - project documentation, build/ - build output (gitignored)
